## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher should obey the required three-attempt retry cap because repeated timeouts currently hold a worker through eight attempts.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetching and health probing with retries, immediate HTTP-error propagation, and parameterized tests. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the review rules; tests were read, not run.

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Limit legacy fetching to three attempts — When the legacy endpoint repeatedly times out, your fetcher makes eight attempts. `docs/review-rules.md:5` requires: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — Eight ten-second timeouts and seven retry delays occupy a worker for about 87 seconds, prolonging worker pressure during an outage. — Fix: Reduce `MAX_ATTEMPTS` to at most 3 and update the legacy case in `tests/test_retries.py`.
